description: Deterministic habit creation, scaling, and stacking rules enforcing Atomic Habits principles

rules.description: Prevent cognitive overload: maximum 3 active concurrent habits.

then.reason: Maximum 3 concurrent habits reached. Master or archive an existing habit first.

rules.description: Law 3 (Make it Easy): Every habit must have an achievable minimum action taking <120 seconds.
Law 1 (Make it Obvious): Every habit must have an unambiguous cue anchor (time, habit stack, or trigger).
Law 1: When habit stack anchor is specified, bind target habit execution immediately after anchor habit.
Identity-Based Habits: Associate habit with an identity statement representing the type of person who exhibits this behavior.
Difficulty Upgrade Gate: Requires ≥80% consistency across 14 consecutive days before difficulty increase.

then.reason: Habit consistency is below 80% over the last 14 days. Consolidate before progressing.
